pick.name: Docker Engine (CE) inside WSL2 Ubuntu
pick.what: Plain dockerd + compose plugin in WSL
pick.why: Free for commercial use on a company-owned laptop, exact Docker CLI/compose/Testcontainers parity

alts.name: Podman Desktop
alts.why: Best GUI with no licence threshold

alts.name: Docker Desktop (Pro subscription)
alts.why: Free only if the owning company has <250 employees AND <$10M revenue; otherwise a paid seat ($9-11/mo Pro)

candidates.name: Docker Desktop
candidates.verdict: licence depends on the company, not you

decision: Docker Desktop is free only for companies under 250 employees and $10M revenue, and on a company-owned laptop that test applies to your employer. Docker CE in WSL has no such test and identical tooling. Keep Docker Desktop only if the company confirms it's under the threshold or you buy a Pro seat.

verify.note: Docker FAQ: Desktop free only for non-commercial OSS or a commercial undertaking with <250 employees AND <US$10M revenue; government entities must pay. Pro $11/mo monthly, $9/mo annual. Open-source Engine is not under the subscription. Pick is sound.
